records.title: 10-K
records.text: Sales grew 9% in fiscal 2021 over fiscal 2020 to $47.0 billion, primarily due to increased average sales prices in each of our segments, partially offset by the impact of an additional week in fiscal 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Each of our segments experienced a shift in demand from foodservice to retail during 2020 and have seen varying levels of foodservice recovery and the return of volumes during fiscal 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The business had a net carrying value of approximately $411 million as of July 6, 2021, which included approximately $44 million of working capital consisting of inventory, accounts receivable and accounts payable, $17 million of property, plant and equipment and $350 million of goodwill.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: These challenges increased our operating costs during fiscal 2020 and fiscal 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We generated $3.8 billion of operating cash flows during fiscal 2021.
